definitions.explanation: A water-filled ditch surrounding a castle or fortification.

examples.english: There is a moat around the castle.

examples.japanese: {堀|ほり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鯉|こい}→こい：02209_koi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→およぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: Carp are swimming in the moat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内堀|うちぼり}→うちぼり：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外堀|そとぼり}→そとぼり：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→のこる：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The inner and outer moats remain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→まち：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→なか：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{堀|ほり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→とおる：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: A canal runs through the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{堀|ほり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦むかし→むかし：01515_mukashi⟧⟦{農業用|のうぎょうよう}→のうぎょうよう：26729_nougyouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→みず：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→はこぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→つくる：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This canal was built long ago to carry water for farming.

notes:
Commonly seen around Japanese castles and historical sites.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{内堀|うちぼり}→うちぼり：noentry⟧ (inner moat)
- ⟦{外堀|そとぼり}→そとぼり：noentry⟧ (outer moat)
- ⟦{空堀|からぼり}→からぼり：noentry⟧ (dry moat)
- ⟦{水堀|みずぼり}→みずぼり：noentry⟧ (water-filled moat)

FAMOUS EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→こうきょ：13607_koukyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{堀|ほり} (Imperial Palace moat in Tokyo)
- ⟦{大阪城|おおさかじょう}→おおさかじょう：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{堀|ほり} (Osaka Castle moat)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{外堀|そとぼり}→そとぼり：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→うめる：01901_umeru⟧ (to fill in the outer moat - to gradually corner someone or prepare the groundwork)
